description: Fetches a single Reddit post by its id. Returns the full post object (title, author, score, text, permalink, subreddit, url). Example: id='abc123' (the base-36 id, no t3_ prefix).

id.description: The post's base-36 id (e.g. 'abc123'), without the 't3_' fullname prefix. Required (path parameter). Required: send `id` or its alias `post_id`.

post_id.description: Alias of `id`; send one of them. `id` is the canonical name.

name: reddit_post
title: Get Post
